claims: UMBC is a public research university in Catonsville, Maryland.
UMBC is known as an "Honors University."
UMBC has roughly 13,000–14,000 students (undergraduate and graduate).
UMBC is frequently ranked among the top 100 most innovative schools by U.S. News & World Report.
UMBC is frequently ranked among the top national universities by U.S. News & World Report.
UMBC has a suburban campus located near Baltimore.
UMBC's campus is approximately 45 minutes from Washington, D.C.
UMBC competes in NCAA Division I.
UMBC's athletics team is the UMBC Retrievers.
UMBC competes in the America East Conference.
UMBC is part of the University System of Maryland.
